newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Bank Exim says cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Bank Exim says cuts deposit rates.

text.p: PT Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia, one of Indonesia's leading state-controlled bank, said on Tuesday it had cut its deposit rates by one percentage point effective immediately.
An official of Bank Exim told Reuters that the bank had lowered its one- and three-month deposit rates to 14.0 percent from 15 percent previously.
It also cut its six- and 12-month deposit rates to 15.0 percent from 16.0 percent.
On Monday, state-owned Bank Negara Indonesia cut all deposit rates by 50 basis points.
Currency dealers said other banks are expected to follow suit.
